lines.text: David defeated the Philistines and took Gath and its villages, and he also defeated the Moabites, who brought him tribute.
David defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah as far as Hamath and kept a hundred horses for the chariots.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus and placed garrisons there, and the LORD made him victorious.
David brought the gold shields to Hebron, and Solomon later used bronze from Tibhath and Cun.
Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Moabites in the Valley of Salt and placed garrisons there.
